WHAT WE AGREE

The details that protect delivery.

Scope and change+

We document included work and exclusions. Changes are assessed for cost and timing before approval.

Security and access+

Access is limited to the work, with named contacts and appropriate data arrangements.

Software and ownership+

Licensing, source access, hosting, third-party dependencies and renewal responsibilities are agreed.

Support after delivery+

Support hours, escalation, maintenance and any handover period are specified in the engagement.
